descriptionChirho: A person sent with a commission, specifically one of the authoritative messengers of Christ — either one of the Twelve, Paul, or more broadly a delegate or envoy of a church. The term apostolos carries the fundamental idea of authorized sending (from apostellein). In the NT it applies to the Twelve (Matt 10:2; Luke 6:13), to Paul (Rom 1:1; 1 Cor 9:1), and occasionally to other commissioned agents (Rom 16:7; 2 Cor 8:23; Phil 2:25). Multilingual evidence is uniform: Spanish 'apóstol/apóstoles,' Hindi 'prerit' (प्रेरित), Arabic 'rasuul/rusul' (رسول/رسل), Korean 'sado' (사도), and Swahili 'mtume/mitume.' The two clusters differ only in number — S63169 (plural: apostles) vs S63170 (singular: apostle) — with no semantic distinction between them.
